bullets.section: New gadget that’s getting a lot of use —
bullets.title: Habor Instant-Read Meat Thermometer
bullets.note: This tiny and cheap (currently $11 on my screen) cooking thermometer works just as well as options I tested for $70–100 only a few years ago. This device can help you avoid cooking proteins that are “black and blue” (overcooked on the outside and undercooked in the middle), and it can help with nearly any dish. Tip for those interested: when in doubt with steak, sear and oven-finish at a lower temp—say, 200–250ºF versus 350–400ºF—à la the “[sexy time steak](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/8kue0m6zzuohlko42bd/6pseh8hwve230q/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueW91dHViZS5jb20vd2F0Y2g_dj1zZV9ZMDNlWXRBYw==).”
